title: The owner's rulings of 2026-09-30 are recorded on their rows: two drops, three closes, 39 parks with a revisit trigger each, and five open rows carrying the ruling

source.ref: owner multiple choice 2026-09-30 ~01:35Z (the owner rows), ~01:45Z (the iOS readiness rows) and ~01:50Z (the P3 sort)

detail:
FILED AND CLOSED 2026-09-30. The owner answered the open owner rows by multiple choice at ~01:35Z, the iOS readiness rows at ~01:45Z and a P3 sort at ~01:50Z. This row records each answer on its row as a fragment (ADR-1635), with the consequence in ADR-1672. No code changes; the only prose outside the ledger is the token expiry in docs/RUNBOOKS.md and .github/workflows/maintenance.yml, and a ruling note under Phase 11 in docs/CORE-MODEL.md.

THE RULINGS, quoted.
1. LIVE-455 (the Phase 11 six-week field test): "Remove this field test". Closed as dropped; the start reading stays in its detail; the PROG-R11 instrument and the weekly sweep reading stay.
2. OWN-011 (Google OAuth verification for contact import): "Park until 75 users". Parked; reopen when Google identities in auth.identities reach 75 (cap 100; about 32 on 2026-08-19).
3. DEF-A2P (A2P 10DLC SMS registration): "Park until SMS is scheduled". Parked; file at least 3 weeks before any SMS feature ships (carrier review 10 to 15 days).
4. OWN-062 (cost baseline and unit economics figures): "Park until revenue". Parked until the first paid production order. Flagged on the row: one event_tickets row was already settled on 2026-09-21, so the ledger reads the trigger as the first paid order after 2026-09-30 until the owner says otherwise.
5. LIVE-060 (the quarterly moderated research round): "Park until launch". Parked to 2026-12-21.
6. LIVE-234 (prove each money loop once in production): "Wait for real customers". Parked to the first real sales (Returning Home, 2026-10-23), still P0, probe unchanged.
7. OWN-074 (Temple of Aset has no Stripe Connect account): "Already handled". NOT closed: production at 01:37Z shows the Returning Home host with stripe_account_id null and charges and payouts disabled. Ruling and reading are both on the row; it stays open.
8. LIVE-273 (SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN expiry): done. Rotated 2026-09-30 to github-actions-frequency-web-2 (project-scoped, read-only, expires 2027-09-28), old tokens deleted, proven by check:migrations on #3089 at 01:28Z (749 ⇄ 749).
9. OWN-085 (the Space email AUP needs counsel): "Ship without counsel review". Closed; the build is LIVE-729, its own PR.
10. OWN-084 / OWN-088 (file backup): the provider is "Cloudflare R2", with env vars R2_ACCOUNT_ID, R2_ACCESS_KEY_ID, R2_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY and R2_BACKUP_BUCKET (bucket frequency-storage-backup) on Vercel Production, the names the HYG-144 build branch already reads. Recorded on OWN-088 (open until they are set), HYG-144 (must read those names) and OWN-084.
11. OWN-083 (Sentry DSN): "Set it up now". Closed: it was already set up on 2026-09-29 18:56Z through the Sentry Vercel integration, and production /api/status reads monitoring.sentry true at 2026-09-30T01:35Z on f7f7d30.
12. OWN-077 and OWN-087 (seed a Journey cohort run; verify a business or practitioner persona): "I'll do both with my Space". Recorded; both stay open.
13. LIVE-714, LIVE-716 to LIVE-723 and LIVE-726 (the iOS readiness build rows), ~01:45Z: "Park with the native app". Parked; they reopen together when the native Expo/React Native build (DEF-MOBILE) starts. LIVE-713, LIVE-715, LIVE-724 and OWN-092 unaffected.
14. The P3 sort, ~01:50Z: park until after launch (reopen on the first real paid order or the first six weeks of live Spaces, whichever comes first) PROG-GD6, LIVE-693, LIVE-664, LIVE-665, LIVE-667, LIVE-708, LIVE-671, LIVE-673, LIVE-663, LIVE-682, LIVE-669, LIVE-668, LIVE-676, LIVE-677, LIVE-675, LIVE-679, LIVE-678, LIVE-690, LIVE-691, LIVE-662, LIVE-658, LIVE-710, LIVE-692 and LIVE-695; drop LIVE-659 ("owner ruled drop 2026-09-30: internal nicety, no user"). Left for their own PRs, untouched: LIVE-656, LIVE-709, LIVE-696, HYG-139, LIVE-681, LIVE-666, LIVE-684, LIVE-689, LIVE-660, LIVE-674, LIVE-655 and LIVE-672.

HOW. check:backlog has four statuses (open, done, parked, blocked), so a dropped row closes as done with DROPPED in its detail and a manual probe saying nothing was proven. Each parked row carries parkedUntil and its trigger in notes, keeps its probe, and leaves its wave by itself (ADR-1635). Two done probes asserted the opposite of these rulings and were amended in the same change, because the rulings change what their done means: HYG-146 held the ten iOS rows active (they move to its held list), and HYG-138 held LIVE-234, DEF-A2P, PROG-GD6 and LIVE-455 unparked and read the base file (it now accepts a row that cites ADR-1672, and reads the merged view). OWN-084's ownerAction moves from ruling to waiting, since no ruling is left there.

CLOSED 2026-09-30 (ADR-1672). The probe reads the merged view and fails on main (f7f7d3075), where LIVE-455 is open.

verify.note: Reads the merged ledger view (ADR-1635) in-process: LIVE-455 and LIVE-659 closed 2026-09-30 as DROPPED; LIVE-273, OWN-085 and OWN-083 closed 2026-09-30; the five owner parks, the ten iOS readiness rows and the 24 P3 rows parked with a parkedUntil note; OWN-074, OWN-088, OWN-077, OWN-087 and HYG-144 still open; every one of them citing ADR-1672; LIVE-455 keeps its start reading; OWN-088 and HYG-144 name Cloudflare R2 and all four R2_* variables (R2_ACCOUNT_ID, R2_ACCESS_KEY_ID, R2_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY, R2_BACKUP_BUCKET) and no BACKUP_S3_* name; ADR-1672 exists (as a fragment, or in DECISIONS.md after compaction, which is read only then).
